meta.title: Prevent over-counting Blob memory usage
meta.body_summary: Fix GC heap size reporting and Blob memory reporting to prevent over-counting memory usage during ReadableStream conversion.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor fix for memory over-counting; no human review, CI reported s3/spawn test timeouts, PR abandoned and closed after ~1 year.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 582 changed lines across Zig runtime and test files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume. As a memory-accounting performance PR it was closed without merge after over a year, consistent with unresolved CI test failures and inactivity.

review_details.concern_detail: robobun CI bot reported multiple test timeouts (s3.test.ts, spawn.test.ts) across platforms after the last commit; no human review text available.
review_details.performance_claim: Fix GC heap size reporting and Blob memory reporting to prevent over-counting memory usage.
review_details.rejection_signals: CI test failures (s3/spawn timeouts) reported by robobun; PR closed after 381 days without further commits, indicating abandonment.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-level Zig memory tracking fix; closure due to test failures and inactivity, not a perf-evidence gap.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler; CI failures indicate potential regressions but not specific to the claimed memory fix.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: robobun reported test failures, possibly unrelated; PR closed after long inactivity without addressing failures.

core_change_summary.description: Modified ByteBlobLoader.zig to fix Blob memory reporting during ReadableStream conversion, updated GarbageCollectionController.zig for GC heap size reporting, and added blob-stream-memory.test.js.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: bun-workspaces.test.ts change is a prettier auto-format unrelated to the memory fix.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: GC heap fix and Blob stream conversion tests added.
Second commit: refined Blob memory reporting, removed temporary test files, added blob-stream-memory.test.js.
Prettier run adjusted formatting in workspaces test and blob-stream-memory test.

review_signals.summary: Robobun reported timeout failures in s3.test.ts and spawn.test.ts across multiple platforms after the last commit.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent opened PR with GC heap and Blob memory reporting fixes.
CI failed with s3/spawn test timeouts (robobun comment).
No follow-up commits to address test failures; PR closed after 381 days without merge.
